005package org.wpilib.datalog;
006
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
009import java.nio.BufferUnderflowException;
010import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
011import java.nio.ByteOrder;
012import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
015import java.util.function.Consumer;
016
017/** Data log reader (reads logs written by the DataLog class). */
018public class DataLogReader implements Iterable<DataLogRecord> {
019  /**
020   * Constructs from the bytes between the byte buffer's current position and limit. The reader does
021   * not modify the buffer's position, limit, or byte order.
022   *
023   * @param buffer byte buffer
024   */
025  public DataLogReader(ByteBuffer buffer) {
026    m_buf = buffer.slice().asReadOnlyBuffer();
027    m_buf.order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
028  }
029
030  /**
031   * Constructs from a file.
032   *
033   * @param filename filename
034   * @throws IOException if unable to open/read file
035   */
036  public DataLogReader(String filename) throws IOException {
037    RandomAccessFile f = new RandomAccessFile(filename, "r");
038    FileChannel channel = f.getChannel();
039    m_buf = channel.map(FileChannel.MapMode.READ_ONLY, 0, channel.size());
040    m_buf.order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
041    channel.close();
042    f.close();
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Returns true if the data log is valid (e.g. has a valid header).
047   *
048   * @return True if valid, false otherwise
049   */
050  public boolean isValid() {
051    return m_buf.remaining() >= 12
052        && m_buf.get(0) == 'W'
053        && m_buf.get(1) == 'P'
054        && m_buf.get(2) == 'I'
055        && m_buf.get(3) == 'L'
056        && m_buf.get(4) == 'O'
057        && m_buf.get(5) == 'G'
058        && m_buf.getShort(6) >= 0x0100;
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Gets the data log version. Returns 0 if data log is invalid.
063   *
064   * @return Version number; most significant byte is major, least significant is minor (so version
065   *     1.0 will be 0x0100)
066   */
067  public short getVersion() {
068    if (m_buf.remaining() < 12) {
069      return 0;
070    }
071    return m_buf.getShort(6);
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Gets the extra header data.
076   *
077   * @return Extra header data
078   */
079  public String getExtraHeader() {
080    ByteBuffer buf = m_buf.duplicate();
081    buf.order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
082    buf.position(8);
083    int size = buf.getInt();
084    byte[] arr = new byte[size];
085    buf.get(arr);
086    return new String(arr, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
087  }
088
089  @Override
090  public void forEach(Consumer<? super DataLogRecord> action) {
091    int size = m_buf.remaining();
092    for (int pos = 12 + m_buf.getInt(8); pos < size; pos = getNextRecord(pos)) {
093      DataLogRecord record;
094      try {
095        record = getRecord(pos);
096      } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
097        break;
098      }
099      action.accept(record);
100    }
101  }
102
103  @Override
104  public DataLogIterator iterator() {
105    return new DataLogIterator(this, 12 + m_buf.getInt(8));
106  }
107
108  private long readVarInt(int pos, int len) {
109    long val = 0;
110    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
111      val |= ((long) (m_buf.get(pos + i) & 0xff)) << (i * 8);
112    }
113    return val;
114  }
115
116  DataLogRecord getRecord(int pos) {
117    try {
118      int lenbyte = m_buf.get(pos) & 0xff;
119      int entryLen = (lenbyte & 0x3) + 1;
120      int sizeLen = ((lenbyte >> 2) & 0x3) + 1;
121      int timestampLen = ((lenbyte >> 4) & 0x7) + 1;
122      int headerLen = 1 + entryLen + sizeLen + timestampLen;
123      final int entry = (int) readVarInt(pos + 1, entryLen);
124      final int size = (int) readVarInt(pos + 1 + entryLen, sizeLen);
125      long timestamp = readVarInt(pos + 1 + entryLen + sizeLen, timestampLen);
126      if (timestamp < 0 || timestamp > Long.MAX_VALUE / 1000) {
127        throw new NoSuchElementException();
128      }
129      timestamp *= 1000;
130      // build a slice of the data contents
131      ByteBuffer data = m_buf.duplicate();
132      data.position(pos + headerLen);
133      data.limit(pos + headerLen + size);
134      return new DataLogRecord(entry, timestamp, data.slice());
135    } catch (BufferUnderflowException | IndexOutOfBoundsException ex) {
136      throw new NoSuchElementException();
137    }
138  }
139
140  int getNextRecord(int pos) {
141    int lenbyte = m_buf.get(pos) & 0xff;
142    int entryLen = (lenbyte & 0x3) + 1;
143    int sizeLen = ((lenbyte >> 2) & 0x3) + 1;
144    int timestampLen = ((lenbyte >> 4) & 0x7) + 1;
145    int headerLen = 1 + entryLen + sizeLen + timestampLen;
146
147    int size = 0;
148    for (int i = 0; i < sizeLen; i++) {
149      size |= (m_buf.get(pos + 1 + entryLen + i) & 0xff) << (i * 8);
150    }
151    return pos + headerLen + size;
152  }
153
154  int size() {
155    return m_buf.remaining();
156  }
157
158  private final ByteBuffer m_buf;
159}
